video_title: Cavs Practice | Jarrett Allen Media Availability | 10.10.2026

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the team's need to adjust to league-wide rebounding trends
quotes.excerpt: Tristan Thompson used to say, just go get the ball and everything will be fine.
quotes.quote: Just learning how to adjust to the league. For me, it's a new league. Everybody is crashing. One through five is crashing. Even for us, we got people crashing that usually aren't crashing. So just trying to adjust to the new era, going to hit the guy instead of waiting for them to come to us. Just wanting to go get it. Tristan Thompson used to say, just go get the ball and everything will be fine.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says the Cavs are adjusting to a new league-wide trend of aggressive rebounding. He notes that even guys who usually do not crash the glass are now getting involved. He adds that he is learning to go hit the guy instead of waiting.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Evan Mobley's integration into the starting lineup
quotes.excerpt: I felt like he adjusted very well to what we were doing.
quotes.quote: I felt like he adjusted very well to what we were doing. We had plenty of reps in training camp, but to do it all on the court in that level amount of time, I thought it went excellent for the team.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says Evan Mobley adjusted well to the starting lineup during training camp, noting that the transition went excellent for the team.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Evan Mobley's specific contributions to the team
quotes.excerpt: His athleticism is going to be huge for us.
quotes.quote: Switchability, three-point shooting, athleticism. Honestly, his athleticism is going to be huge for us. His ability to stab on one play and get back to his man and be able to contest another shot.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen highlights Evan Mobley's defensive versatility, specifically pointing to his switchability and athleticism as key assets for the Cavs this season.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the benefits of Evan Mobley having a full training camp
quotes.excerpt: He's understood the system, how we play, how the locker room works.
quotes.quote: For me, I had to learn on the fly. You don't know all the plays coming out when you get traded mid-season. But for Evan Mobley, he's been here two weeks before training camp, so he's understood the system, how we play, how the locker room works. He's understanding everything. He has time to adjust.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen notes the advantage of Evan Mobley having a full training camp to learn the system, contrasting it with his own experience of having to learn on the fly after a mid-season trade.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the value of James Harden's input during training camp
quotes.excerpt: We're able to get his input on a lot of things.
quotes.quote: It's huge and we're able to get his input on a lot of things. Last season, you don't really want to change too many things up during the season, especially when you're getting so close to the postseason. But now, his input means a lot to how much it's going to change the offense and defense.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says James Harden's input during training camp is huge for the team, noting that it is significantly impacting how the Cavs are shaping their offense and defense.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the pick-and-roll chemistry with James Harden
quotes.excerpt: He's an excellent pick-and-roll player. You can call him one of the best.
quotes.quote: It's super exciting. He's an excellent pick-and-roll player. You can call him one of the best. I feel like I'm pretty good at pick-and-roll myself and we're able to adjust to any type of defense at any time.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen is excited about his pick-and-roll chemistry with James Harden, calling him one of the best in the league at running the action.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Jaylen Brown's competitive mindset heading into the season
quotes.excerpt: He's a competitor. At the end of the day, he wants to be on the court.
quotes.quote: He took a lot of that to heart. He's a competitor. At the end of the day, he wants to be on the court, he wants to fight and go against the best guys. I think he has every right to be upset with himself, but I think he's going to let that get to his mind too much and his next step is just understanding that, yeah, he did get fooled, but learn from that and grow from that and be a better player next time.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen on Jaylen Brown's competitive mindset, saying he has every right to be upset with himself but needs to learn and grow from his mistakes to become a better player.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on holding teammates accountable for defensive breakdowns
quotes.excerpt: I called the screen, you got to listen to me.
quotes.quote: The conversations are good. I had the conversation during the game. It was like, I guess this is what Malik Beasley, but with Jaylen Brown as well. It was like, Malik thought he could get over a screen and I was calling a different coverage. I had to tell the young fella, I called the screen, you got to listen to me. I told him, if the play messes up, that's on me. You're just listening to the guy in the back and do it well. But they're all receptive, they're all willing to learn, they're all willing to grow.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says he is taking a leadership role in defensive communication, telling teammates to listen to him on the back line because if the play fails, that is on him.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the development expectations for Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.excerpt: Now it's time to actually get on the court when the minutes matter.
quotes.quote: Donovan Mitchell the other day talked about Tyrese Haliburton, kind of now going to that stage where Jaylen Brown was last year, second-year jump. The expectation is still to grow, especially for somebody in Tyrese's shoes who hasn't got a lot of minutes on the actual NBA court. But still to prove what you have. He's an excellent NBA player. He's shown that many times and time again. But now it's time to actually get on the court when the minutes matter and show that he belongs.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen discusses the expectations for Tyrese Haliburton, saying it is time for him to prove he belongs on the court when the minutes matter.
